purpose: Collect structured application details while reducing visual length through safe layout grouping.
audience: Applicants or prospective clients completing a detailed form

field_settings.layout: two-column grouping only for short personal-detail fields; long text and consent remain full width
field_settings.ready_classes: migrate rather than add for new work

confirmations.name: Application received
confirmations.message: Thanks. We have received your application and will review it.

accessibility_settings.mobile: columns must collapse without hiding labels or errors
accessibility_settings.keyboard: focus order must match visual order

embedding_target.method: Gravity Forms block or existing shortcode
embedding_target.style_strategy: layout controls first; CSS only by approved handoff

data_retention_notes: Application data retention and consent evidence retention must be agreed with the client before launch.
risks: Conditional logic can create broken row layout when one field is hidden
Mobile wrapping can make a shorter desktop form harder to complete
